suitability.rationale: Directly measures purified haspin biochemical activity and appropriately limits cellular conclusions.
response_quotes: Purified recombinant human haspin kinase (Q8TF76) with a peptide/protein substrate in a biochemical reaction

procedural_soundness.rationale: Preparation, reaction, ATP depletion, detection and analysis are coherently ordered with intended controls. Substrate identity, enzyme and ATP concentrations, timing and detection volumes remain unresolved. Interference is acknowledged without an operational counter-screen. This is an honest outline, not an executable procedure.
response_quotes: Stop the reaction with ADP-Glo reagent to deplete residual ATP, then add kinase detection reagent and read luminescence.
unresolved — substrate identity and concentration not specified in packet

numerical_soundness.rationale: The explicit lower endpoint contradicts the specified series: 30/3^9 = 0.00152416 µM = 1.52416 nM, not approximately 5 nM. Most assumptions are disclosed, but solvent compatibility is asserted without supporting solubility or tolerance data.
response_quotes: A 10-point 3-fold series from 30 µM spans ~5 nM–30 µM
which should bracket an IC50 in that contextual range while remaining solvent-compatible.

critical_failures.response_quote: A 10-point 3-fold series from 30 µM spans ~5 nM–30 µM
critical_failures.reason: The claimed lower concentration is about 3.28 times the actual tenth concentration; prose and numerical settings do not describe the same series.

not_assessable_components: Compatibility of retained assays with the proposed haspin preparation, substrate and ATP conditions.
Optimal enzyme, substrate, buffer, ATP, reaction time and detection settings are not supplied.
Compound solubility and enzyme/reagent tolerance at 1% DMSO and 30 µM compound.
assumption_handling: Most numerical choices are labeled assumptions and retained potencies correctly treated as contextual. Essential parameters are honestly unresolved. Solvent compatibility is unsupported; the blanket claim that all numeric reaction conditions are unresolved also conflicts with the provisional 25 °C binding.

numeric_check.notes: Series spans 1.52416 nM–30 µM and 4.294 decimal orders, versus prose approximately 5 nM and 4.5 orders. Triplicates are explicitly technical.

review_reason: Numerical endpoint error, unresolved assay comparability and operating conditions, and unsupported solvent compatibility require review.
